line: So many cars, I don’t even bend my shoes (Yeah)
vault_lines: So many cars, I don't even bend my shoes (Yeah)
meaning:
Uzi is showing his wealth through “So many cars” showing us that he has a lot of varieties of cars

He then says “I don’t even bend my shoes” showing that he has so “many cars” that he doesn’t even walk meaning he doesn’t crease (bend) his shoes which ruins the shoe
